units.source_text: 「只想喝酒嗎？那我也陪你喝一會兒吧。」

en.t: Do you only want to drink? Then I will keep you company for a while too.
It was a cold autumn night.

units.source_text: 按照常子（記得她叫這個名字，但記憶模糊，不太確定。

en.t: At Tsuneko's direction (I remember that was her name, but my memory is hazy and I am not quite sure,

units.source_text: 我這個人竟然連一起殉情自殺的人叫什麼都記不住）的吩咐，

en.t: I am the sort of person who cannot even remember the name of the person with whom I tried to die in a lovers' suicide),

units.source_text: 在銀座后街的一家露天壽司攤鋪上，

en.t: at an open-air sushi stall in a back street of Ginza,

units.source_text: 一邊吃著難吃的壽司，一邊等她（雖然忘了她的名字，

en.t: I waited for her while eating terrible sushi (although I forgot her name,

units.source_text: 但那家難吃的壽司我卻記憶猶新。

en.t: I still remember that terrible sushi vividly.

units.source_text: 還有長得像黃頷蛇的光頭老闆，搖頭晃腦地捏著壽司，佯裝一副手藝高超的樣子，至今仍歷歷在目。

en.t: Even now I can clearly see the bald proprietor, who looked like a Japanese rat snake, bobbing his head as he shaped the sushi and pretending to be highly skilled.
